full_judgment: Mr. S. A. N. Mominur Rahman, J : This Rule is directed against the impugned order dated 23.2.94 passed in Title Appeal No. 70 of 1993 by the learned District Judge Gopalganj rejecting the application filed under Order 41 Rule 19 of the Code of Civil Procedure holding the same to be not maintainable. At the time of the issuance of the Rule the delay was condoned subject to any just objection if raised at the time of the healing of the Rule. The learned Advocate appearing for the opposite party did not raise any objection of the point of limitation.
